title: Hang nước
about: Round x3 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked for many more versions ("tôi rất thích các phiên bản bạn tạo, hãy tạo thêm cho tôi nhiều phiên bản khác"): a cave with water: drops falling into a still pool on the chord's tones, the wind in the hollow and the dark pad; E minor at 50 bpm, a slow sway to C and the Phrygian F. An original piece.
